column4: Named sites bounded (history caps, 64MiB line cap, 16KB bash tail; bounded-exec/remote-agent tests); API read_file still reads whole sandbox file (tools.ts:894).
Only ProviderFailure/ProviderStreamError classify as limits; adapter catch-all reclassification removed. Tests: limits, agent-stream-close, codex-app-server, agent-admission, claude-terminal.
Retry-After/'try again in'/60s default added in a2afe96f then reverted by e6cedcbd for task #385; API-key 429 still parks login 5h.
Claude and Codex API rails catch tool exceptions and return is_error tool results; failed signal_completion not success. Test: agent-api-errors.
Export limited to the turn's session (plus Codex lineage); divergent Claude history rejected, newer host copy kept. Test: remote-agent.
Persistent streaming TextDecoders per stdout/stderr/PTY in e2b.ts (sdkText stream:true). Test: e2b-world.
Remote-world provider failures unwrapped to plain errors; cannot park shared logins (trade-off: genuine sandbox limits stay task-local). Tests: claude-terminal, remote-agent.
Boot migration no longer strips maxTurns; SDK receives input/profile maxTurns (backstop 1000). Tests: claude-terminal, store.
account_on_hold/verification_required/cloud_credential_error map to hard credential; other assistant errors fail the turn without parking. Test: claude-terminal.
'credit balance is too low' now a hard quota failure (legacy replays unchanged). Tests: limits, workflow-failures.
Codex killAgent/stop, MCP close and Claude work cleanup no longer replace outcomes; history export best-effort. Tests: agent-native-cleanup, agent-api-errors, claude-terminal.
Browser readiness cached, export limited to current session (remote-agent test). Remain: node install-check+expose, serial bootstrap, per-turn work-env dir, full transcript re-read.
No commit (listed in task #394, untouched). codex-history*.ts and ensure*CodexSessionTools unchanged: every resumed turn re-reads, re-parses and republishes the whole lineage.
REGRESSION? 00003a84 (LT-5) restored cumulative emit (acp.ts:490); 150ms coalescing (runtime.ts:96) bounds row rate, but each agent.output row holds full text.
ACP terminal output retention clamped to 1 MiB regardless of provider outputByteLimit (acp.ts:432). Test: acp-agent.
findClaudeSession now picks the largest copy across homes (mtime tie-break) instead of first readdir match. Test: fork.
KARMAX_CUSTODY_CHAIN added to the agent-visible env allowlist (config-homes.ts:466). Test: custody.
REGRESSION? Root signalled only if /proc start tick matches; on non-Linux hosts startMatches/custodyProcesses are empty, so killAgent signals nothing (custody.ts:201,305). Test: custody.
KARMAX_TOKEN no longer in --mcp-config (MCP inherits harness env); codex exec prompt sent on stdin ('-'). Tests: codex-exec, claude-terminal, conversation-history.
Interval steering tracked as one promise; completed-turn drain awaits it before pulling follow-ups, preventing double delivery. Test: codex-app-server.
OAuth refresh-resume carries acknowledged deliveredMessages boundary and merged follow-ups instead of resending the whole delta. Test: claude-oauth-delivery.
Codex app-server and exec stderr kept to a 64 KiB tail; exec stdout decoded with setEncoding('utf8'). Test: codex-exec.
Stopping an agent root now cancels its owning task through the authorized signal API, not a raw retried signal. Tests: processes, gateway-processes.
configFiles excludes karmax-oauth.json and karmax-work-*.config.toml from remote seeding. Test: remote-agent.
Every seeded config file (skills, settings) is rewritten each turn instead of only when absent. Test: remote-agent.
Blank, malformed, negative or overflowing KARMAX_AGENT_BG_SETTLE_MS falls back to 5 min; explicit 0 still opts out. Test: agent-stream-close.
Local Claude spawn pipes stderr into a 64 KiB tail; startup diagnostics publish allowlisted error signatures. Test: claude-terminal.
Transport 408/50x/529 match now needs HTTP/status/API context; bare counts like '500-iteration' no longer retry. Test: limits.
Checked OK in review (memory guard victim choice); not a finding.
Checked OK in review (shell quoting); not a finding.
Checked OK in review (reapOrphans pid reuse); not a finding.
Checked OK in review (Claude idle/result logic); not a finding.
runAgentTurn keeps only replies to the task's own children (store parentTaskId) before the workflow signals; sole path. Test: subtask-response-scope.
Signal route 404s non-tasks; only public signals (followUp/confirm/openPr/approveCheckout/cancel/retry) or declared actions allowed. Test: platform-authz.

App-connection waits now signal-driven (workflow-review-regressions test). Hosted admission (software-dev.ts:1823, agent-turn-lease.ts:173) and GitHub waits (:3762,:3875) still poll; no continue-as-new.
Recovery checkpoint dropped from liveInput (workflow-review-regressions test). Full transcript still passed per turn into history; no continue-as-new, so 50MB limit remains.

Coordinator continues-as-new at safe boundaries even with queued work (history>=10k/suggested), carrying accounts, queue, granted. Tests: coordinator-history, coordinator-health, workflows, quota-coordinator.
leaseAccount fails closed (missing:policy-unavailable) without a policy; runAgentTurn rejects leased homes/keys outside the task's org. Tests: model-credential-routing, quota-coordinator.
changeWorkflow requires review:approve for an agent switching its task to Goal (no Review gate). Test: stage-transitions.

Replacement no longer cancels children or closes their PRs; new run restores child barrier, childSettled signal reports results. Tests: child-recovery, child-recovery-workflow, workflow-review-regressions.
just-do catches CredentialUnavailable (patched) and parks in a cancellable human wait instead of failing the workflow task forever. Test: workflow-review-regressions.
merge-only final gate (patched) waits for confirmed && mayConfirm, so Confirm cannot merge a workflow edit with failed checks. Test: workflow-review-regressions.
Cancellation rechecked (patched) after publish/admission awaits before invoking the turn, in software-dev and agent-turn-lease. Test: workflow-review-regressions.
Human confirm layers republish status 'waiting' (patched) in software-dev, just-do and merge-only, so the confirmation cycle resets stale votes. Test: workflow-review-regressions.
isTaskAlive treats only WorkflowNotFoundError or a non-RUNNING execution as dead; transport errors rethrow and retry. Test: coordinator-health.
Child nags and Do/Responder rounds capped at three (patched), then park for human guidance; human or child progress resets. Test: workflow-review-regressions.
Managed workers get a 45-minute shutdown grace, retired runs drain in background; failed install no longer triggers a rollback roll. Tests: worker-refresh, worker-manager-shutdown.
accountPoolSize no longer caught to 0 (patched) and is re-read before each agent turn. Test: workflow-review-regressions.
Child delegation attenuated against the parent's current stored grant (plus approved extensions, live Avatar), not start-time grant. Tests: role-defaults, payments.
Credential order returns passthrough [] when the org has no keys but the funded managed rail is eligible (shared check). Test: agent-admission.
In-process WorkerManager now gets terminateOnWorkerFailure (SIGTERM for supervisor restart), same as process mode. Test: worker-failure.
restore() stages manifests/bundle maps and registers only after worker refresh succeeds; boot awaits the bundle instead of swallowing. Test: workflow-manager-restore.

REGRESSION? Identity checked via /proc before SIGKILL; on non-Linux a live recorded server is unverifiable, so wedged-server replacement and reset throw (dev-server.ts:201-205). Tests: temporal-server-identity, reset-process.
Grant racing cancellation is returned (software-dev, patched); lease path returns via finally; no double inUse decrement. Tests: workflow-review-regressions, coordinator-history.
Account coordinator (policy v2) ignores retried lease requests already in the grant ledger. Test: coordinator-history.
Merge queue continues-as-new at safe boundaries even with a live holder or queued work, carrying current and queue. Tests: coordinator-history, coordinator-health.
budget.ts unchanged and still registered though unused. #372 report says skipped to preserve historical balances; no commit explains it.
runScript heartbeats every 10s through world open and command; script-exec (patched) sets a 1-minute heartbeat timeout. Test: script-heartbeat.
saveView still has no ordering/sequence guard (db.ts:3710). #372 report defers it pending a run-distinguishing fence; no commit.
No change: hosted activity cap was already 1000 at base; WFT 8 and workflow cache 20 unchanged (env-configurable). #372 skipped it; no commit.
Declared resolve rules run in a vm Script with 25 ms timeout, input capped at 64 KiB head+tail, max 500 rules. Test: roles.
